It was built on a 200 meter high conical hill in the 12th century by King Yadava Bhillama V, and was named the Devgiri. short_summary: Hanuman temple described at Khuldabad.
main_description_about:
Shree Bhadra Maruti Mandir is the oldest temple dedicated to Lord Hanuman ji where Lord Hanuman Ji is in a sleeping position. It is located at Khuldabad in Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar (Aurangabad), Maharashtra.
The temple was found to have existed since the Ramayana period, and the old name of this temple used to be known as ‘Bhadravathi.’ The King of Bhadravathi used to be Bhadrasen, who was the Devotee of Lord Ram. Once the king of this place was singing hymns. While hearing the hymns, The Lord Hanumanji came to this place, and listening to the sweet hymns went in a sleeping posture. Seeing like this King Bhadra Sen Prayed to the Lord Hanumanji ji to stay here forever. After that, the temple was built in this place by King Bhadrasen.
This is one of the three temples in India where Lord Hanumanji can be seen in a resting posture, two of these temples are located in different places. The second one is at the banks of Ganga Sangam in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, and the third one is at Jam Sawali in Madhya Pradesh.
The temple is a spiritual site and a beautiful tourist attraction, as a large number of devotees reach there at the time of festivals like Hanuman Jayanti & Ram Navami. Many people arrive there from Aurangabad and nearby Village to take Darshan’s on Tuesday & Saturday also.
It is very close from Ellora Caves .

short_summary: Shiva temple described in Ambhora village within Kuhi tehsil.
main_description_about:
Shree Chaitanyeshwar Temple is the most popular and revered spiritual destination. The temple is dedicated to Lord shiva and holds deep religious significance for devotees across the region. It is located in the peaceful village Ambhora, which comes under Kuhi Tehsil in Nagpur district, Maharashtra, The temple is situated at the confluence of five rivers: Kanhan, Wainganga, Murza, Kolari, and Aam. These five rivers meet near the temple, surrounding it with natural beauty and a calm rural landscape.
According to mythology The Shiva Lingam appeared naturally on its own. Long ago, there was a dense forest in this area and sages and saints used to do penance here. After the appearance of Shivalinga, the temple was gradually built here, It is considered to be the holy place of Lord Shiva, hence the people around worship it with great devotion.
There are also several small temples within the temple premises, such as Shree Harinath Mandir, Shree Vitthal Rukmini Mandir, Shree Ganga Mata Mandir & Ganesh Mandir, and many more, where devotees can visit and seek blessings.

The temple’s timeless presence enhances the spiritual aura of the surroundings, offering visitors a place for prayer, peace, and reflection.
The lake area also becomes lively during local festivals and religious occasions, where cultural traditions and community gatherings bring the place to life. The combination of natural beauty and spiritual heritage makes Gandhi Sagar Lake a unique and meaningful destination.

short_summary: Hill fort near Harshewadi and Nirgudpada in Trimbakeshwar tehsil.
main_description_about:
The most popular historical mountain peak is the Harihar Fort in Maharashtra, also known as Harshagad, located in the Sahyadri (Western Ghats) mountain range near Harshewadi village & Nirgudpada village at Trimbakeshwar Tehsil in Nashik district.
The fort is built on triangular-shaped rocks, and two edges of the fort are 90 degrees & third edge is 75 degrees inclined to the west. The Height of the fort is 3676 feet (1,120 meters) vertically tall from sea level.
It is very famous for the steep rock, and 117 rock cut stairs are made at an inclined angle of 80 degrees to climb up the hill, and there are small pits to grip to hold hands, from where you can easily climb upwards while holding the stairs’ pits, and it has the temple of Lord Hanuman and Lord Shiva on top of the hill.
The primary purpose of this fort was to maintain military surveillance and security, protecting the major trade routes, especially those in the Nashik region.
It is an attractive tourist site known for the great experience of trekking and knowledge of historical significance about the fort, and a huge number of people gather here during the rainy and winter seasons for hiking and to enjoy the stunning and breathtaking views of the surrounding Sahyadri mountains, Bhaskar gadh, Anjaneri Fort and Bramhagiri parvat.

short_summary: Shiva pilgrimage temple in Trimbak, Nashik district.
main_description_about:
Shree Trimbakeshwar Jyotirlinga Temple is a very famous Mandir and nestled in the foothills of the Brahmagiri Mountains. This is one of the 12 jyotirlingas in India which is dedicated to Tridev, Lord Bramha, Vishnu and Mahesh. The jyotirlinga is crowned by jewels from the times of the pandavs. There are 3 faces of lingams in a circular pit, and it is located at Trimbak town in Nashik of Maharashtra. Trimbak is a town as well as a tehsil too. It is an ancient Hindu pilgrim place, and is situated at the source of the Godavari River, which is one of the holiest rivers in India.
This temple was present from the period of the Satavahana dynasty and later re-constructed in the place of the old temple in the 18th century (1740-1760) by Peshwa Balaji Baji Rao (also known as Nana Saheb).
The temple is built in the Hemadpanti architectural style, characterized by complex carvings, sculptures and decorative design and patterns made of black stone to enhance the beauty of the temple, and is also known as the Black Stone Temple. The temple holds huge religious significance in the heart of Hindus. You can also visit the Harihar fort nearby, 14.9 km from the Trimbkeshwar temple.
opening_hours: Open daily from 5:30 AM to 9:00 PM
